newsitem.title: LEBANON: Pro-Israeli militiaman wounded in Lebanon blast.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Israeli militiaman wounded in Lebanon blast.

text.p: A pro-Israeli militiaman was wounded on Tuesday when Moslem guerrillas set off a bomb near his patrol in south Lebanon, militia sources said.

They said the blast occurred as South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiamen were on a foot patrol near the outpost of Anan in Jizzine, a finger of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.
In Beirut, Hizbollah (Party of God) said its guerrillas carried out the attack which it said wounded several militiamen.
"One of the wounded is a South Lebanon Army top officer in the area of Kfar Falous in Jizzine," a spokesman for the Moslem group said.
But the militia sources said only one militiaman was wounded.
The pro-Iranian group leads an Islamic Resistance committed to ousting Israeli troops and their allies from a 15 km (nine mile) wide occupation zone.
Tuesday's attack brought to four the number of SLA militiamen wounded in guerrilla attacks since the beginning of the year. One Israeli soldier was killed and 11 were wounded over the same period.
